[Crime No. 17 of 2019]

Prayer : Petition filed under Section 430 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita to suspend the sentence imposed against the petitioner and release him on bail pending disposal of the main criminal appeal before this court against judgment of the Sessions Judge, Fast Track Mahila Court, Theni in Spl S.C. No. 87 of 2019, dated 7-6-2023

ORDER

When this petition is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this court to withdraw this petition. He has also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. Permission is granted. This petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
